40  Hydrocarbon X is saturated. Each molecule contains one ring of carbon atoms.

   The mass spectrum of hydrocarbon X is measured.

   The peak representing the M+ ion is 14 mm high.

   The peak representing the [M+1]+ ion is 0.77 mm high.

   What is the m / e value for the M+ ion of X?

   A  56        B  58        C  70        D  72
